hooks.command: pnpm --dir "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" exec node scripts/command-guard.js || { status=$?; [ "$status" = 2 ] || echo "The command guard did not run: pnpm --dir \"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\" exec node scripts/command-guard.js exited with status $status.
